value.rationale: The natural statistical question of which nominal confidence level makes time-averaged conventional-interval coverage most unstable is resolved with a proof of uniqueness, not just a table search. The exact optimizer at about 59.3192% and the distinct sharp endpoint laws quantify regimes not settled by the existing numerical variance table; the small-band nonanalytic cubic term and the high-confidence factor four arise from different covariance boundary layers. These are intrinsic distributional invariants of the already-motivated coverage functional, with reproducible one-variable quadrature.
